acceptance: find_stub_adapter_attr_leaks in tests/integration/platforms/conftest.py ignores __warningregistry__ in before/after attribute diffs
A test in tests/integration/platforms/test_stub_installer_isolation.py confirms __warningregistry__ on an adapter module is ignored by find_stub_adapter_attr_leaks
Existing stub-installer leak detection continues to flag true adapter attribute leaks
context:
Diagnosed during triage of nightly runs 37638195854, 37784986221, and 37794806634 for GitHub issue #2729. The ClickHouse setup module has no warnings.warn call; the warning reaches the module namespace via stacklevel from a library in the live connection path.

Closed 2026-10-09 (batch tuning-local-20261009): already merged in PR #2789, merge commit adeb6c5fae4630cd2c187d294710c32de1c829f5 (ancestor of origin/develop 01c9d7375). Verified on that head: `_IGNORED_LEAK_ATTRS = frozenset({"__warningregistry__"})` at tests/integration/platforms/conftest.py:405 (used at :423 and :436), and `test_stub_installer_ignores_warningregistry` at tests/integration/platforms/test_stub_installer_isolation.py:73. `gh pr view 2789` reports MERGED. No new PR.
description: In tests/integration/platforms/conftest.py, find_stub_adapter_attr_leaks compares adapter module attributes before and after tests to detect un-monkeypatched stub-installer mutations. When code paths trigger a Python warning attributed to an adapter module, CPython attaches __warningregistry__ to module.__dict__. The leak guard flags this as a leak (e.g. benchbox.platforms.clickhouse.setup.__warningregistry__), causing teardown failures in t3:docker | clickhouse on the first test per pytest-xdist worker process.
